description: Create a home appliance warranty tracking spreadsheet. Design a table with columns for: Appliance Name, Brand/Model, Purchase Date, Warranty (Years), Warranty Expires (calculated), and Status (calculated). Enter data for at least 3 appliances with realistic information. In the 'Warranty Expires' column, create formulas to calculate expiration dates by adding warranty years to purchase dates. In the 'Status' column, create conditional formulas using IF and TODAY() to show 'EXPIRED', 'EXPIRING SOON' (within 90 days), or 'ACTIVE'. Save the spreadsheet as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/appliance_warranty_tracker.xlsx.
